description: Abstract writer — Write a structured scientific abstract (background, objective, methods, results, conclusions) plus keywords from paper or report text, using only facts in the text. Offline checks: word count vs limit, numbers not found in the source, results without numbers, keywords present in the text, compression ratio. Optional: maxWords (80-500, default 250), style=structured|plain. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. We enrolled 240 adults with stage 1 hypertension in a 12-week randomized trial comparing a daily walking program with usual care. The primary outcome was change in systolic blood pressure. Walking reduced systolic pressure by 8.4 mmHg versus 2.1 mmHg with usual care (p<0.01). Adherence averaged 87 percent and no serious adverse events occurred. A simple walking program meaningfully lowers blood pressure.

name: ai_abstract
